node.statement: Validated endpoint bridge addressing ch-07c969407f5321dd. The challenge described an earlier ledger state. In the current ledger nodes 1.3 and 1.4 are validated. Moreover the current statement of 1.3 has the non-strict estimate ||h_11,n v_n-mu_11,n||<=kappa*e, and validated child 1.3.1.1 proves its endpoint explicitly: when e=0, nonnegativity of delta and epsilon gives delta=epsilon=0, the amplified multiplicative and unit defects of T vanish, one takes mu_11=T, and the distance is 0=kappa*e; when e>0, validated correction node 1.2 gives the strict estimate and hence the non-strict one. Thus validated 1.3 supplies the comparison on all e>=0, and validated 1.4 supplies h_jk,n^{-1}=I_n tensor h_jk^{-1} and injectivity. Consequently d_11,n has norm at most kappa*e, every other d_jk,n is zero, and the displayed H-CB adjointness/spatial-adjoint chain followed by injectivity proves exact amplified involution compatibility. No strict inequality at e=0 is used.
